notes: Strip c: x 3750-4940, overlap to x 3450 and 5240. Plate 69 is turned (not north-up). Several streets have an interior line drawn inside the roadway (car tracks/curb); points use the outer frontage lines. Unnamed: the 40 ft street from the Melbourne/Mathers junction ENE past Rammelsberg to Beresford prints only 'ST.' (recorded '?'); the stub off Gilbert's SE side at x~4405 prints 'SP...' (cut by plate edge, recorded '?'). Mathers Avenue label reads 'MATHERS ... E.' (AVE. assumed). Walters Avenue: 'WALTERS' printed SSW of Altoona, 'AVE.' NE of Altoona on the same alignment. Melbourne Terrace (x~4250 y~5200) and Washington Terrace (x~3700 y~5000) are named courts printed across house lots with no drawn opening onto Melbourne Street: not picked. Hague Alley meets Beresford at about (5345,5182), outside the overlap: not picked. Kerper/Wehrman (~3320,6700) and the E-W avenue ending at the railroad at (3700,3830) are west of x 3450 or not crossings: not picked. Victory Boulevard's NE leg would meet Lexington at about x 5300, outside the overlap. Windham and Gilbert NE bends are approximate (+-20-25 px).
